subject: RENAMES clause
notes: kb/Work PB1284: the range (GR1: data-name-2 and its subordinates; GR2: data-name-2 through the last entry of data-name-3's subtree, declaration order, groups and REDEFINES views included) is screened before either RENAMES form binds: an occurs-depending table, a variable-length data item (dynamic-length elementary item or dynamic-capacity table, §8.5.1.11.1) or an item of class object/message-tag/pointer (SR14's phrase reader) is refused COBOL2561; the strongly-typed arms stay COBOL1532 (§13.18.57.3 SR3). A range ending before a trailing ODO table is legal and unchanged.
